2026_02_CAR_ATL.headline: Carolina tests Atlanta’s short-handed quarterback plan behind Cooper Rush
2026_02_CAR_ATL.paragraph1: Atlanta will start Cooper Rush again with Michael Penix Jr. ruled out, putting more pressure on Bijan Robinson and the Falcons’ protection after Rush struggled when pressured in the opener. Carolina’s defense was gashed by Chicago, so the Panthers need cleaner early-down fits and a pass rush that forces obvious passing situations. Bryce Young and Carolina’s offense, meanwhile, have an opportunity to make Atlanta chase points rather than dictate the game through Robinson.
2026_02_CAR_ATL.model_rationale: Carolina’s path depends on forcing Atlanta away from a comfortable run-first script while protecting Bryce Young well enough to sustain drives and pressure Rush to answer.
